Projects.title: OCR Document Verification for Social Protection
desc: An AI/OCR-based automated supporting document verification system engineered for social protection and health insurance services, systematically validating documentary evidence against applicant claims.

Built during the Berlin Hackathon hosted by GIZ Germany at the SAP Data Space (Feb 2026), the engine extracts structured parameters from unstructured uploaded citizen documents and cross-checks them in real-time against application declarations.

The architecture dramatically reduces manual verification effort by 75%, enhances automated detection of inconsistencies and fraudulent submissions, and provides a standardized API ready for direct integration into openIMIS and national social registries.

Projects.title: From Claim to Care: Global Goods Interoperability
desc: A breakthrough digital health architecture and interoperability model presented at the Global Digital Health Forum (GDHF) in Nairobi, Kenya (Dec 2025).

The solution establishes an end-to-end data exchange pipeline connecting Community Health Worker (CHW) frontline feedback with health financing and insurance systems using openIMIS as the central catalyst for interoperability.

Designed to accelerate Universal Health Coverage (UHC), the architecture links care delivery with claims adjudication, giving ministries of health and international donors real-time visibility into healthcare service delivery and financing.

Projects.title: openCRVS × openIMIS Interoperability Pipeline
desc: An end-to-end interoperability implementation connecting civil registration (openCRVS) with national health insurance (openIMIS) under the GIZ Support to Health Sector Strategy (S2HSS).
Configured openHIM mediator for secure transaction routing, logging, and automated syncing of vital event updates (births, deaths, demographic transitions) directly into health insurance registries.
Implemented Digital Convergence Initiative (DCI) APIs, HL7 FHIR protocols, and openHIE architectural guidelines, eliminating manual dual-entry and accelerating newborn health coverage enrollment.

Projects.title: Legacy to Modular openIMIS Architecture Migration
desc: Spearheading the comprehensive architectural migration of national openIMIS installations from a monolithic legacy stack to a modern, decoupled microservice paradigm.
Engineered decoupled modules for contributor management, claims adjudication, and reporting with high availability and throughput for multi-tier national infrastructure.
Ensured zero-downtime transition, backward data compatibility across millions of beneficiary records, and standardized REST/GraphQL interfaces for third-party hospital EHRs.

Projects.title: Social Security Fund Nepal Enterprise Automation
desc: Enterprise-scale module development and system customization for the Social Security Fund (SSF) of Nepal in partnership with the International Labour Organization (ILO).

Architected and deployed full-lifecycle operational modules: Formal Sector Contributor Registration, Payment Collection, Grievance Handling, Medical/Non-Medical Claims, Investment, and Loan Management.
Engineered automated duplicate claims detection rules across facilities and supported HL7 FHIR integration between hospital Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and SSF.

Projects.title: Lao PDR National Health Insurance System Analysis
desc: Technical requirement analysis, stakeholder alignment, and system customization mapping for the Ministry of Health (MoH) Lao PDR in collaboration with the Asia eHealth Information Network (AeHIN) and WHO.
Led detailed stakeholder workshops with the Ministry of Health and technical teams to adapt international digital health standards to the Lao national health strategy.
Demonstrated and configured openIMIS for digital claims submission, automated verification workflows, beneficiary tracking, and executive analytics.

Projects.title: Sarovara On-Demand E-Commerce & Mobile Logistics
desc: A full-stack on-demand product ordering and logistics platform developed for Grantha Technology.
Built cross-platform iOS and Android applications using Flutter alongside a high-performance backend with Django REST framework and PostgreSQL.
Features geofenced store dispatching, live delivery tracking, payment gateway integration, and real-time inventory management.

Projects.title: Government ICT Infrastructure & Systems Design
desc: Long-term ICT engineering and systems consultancy for the Office of the Attorney General, Government of Nepal.
Formulated government IT operational guidelines, systems architecture, and security specifications for legal case tracking.
Deployed and administered high-availability VMware virtualization clusters, Linux server farms, and secure Windows Server infrastructure.
